recommendations.policy_profitable_at_any_offset: If false, re-check policy params / optimize overfit under cost stress.
recommendations.timing_sensitive: If true, move entry timing earlier/later by best offset and retest OOS.
recommendations.direction_ambiguous: If true, add regime-conditioned direction model (fade vs follow).
recommendations.gap_risk_material: If true, include gap-through-stop repricing and widen buffers/limits.
recommendations.cost_sensitivity_high: If true, reduce turnover and tighten cost assumptions in training objective.
